text:
Type: linen cushion
Use: back support and decoration on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, Japandi
Materials: washed linen with a fine slub texture
Colors: light warm beige, greige
Shape: square plain cushion, soft rounded corners, clean seamed edges, slightly crumpled natural texture, medium size
Feel: calm, natural, soft, relaxed
Goes with: white or grey sofas, light oak, wool throws, stone tones; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist living rooms

product.name: VIGDIS
product.description: The cushion cover is made of ramie, a hard-wearing natural material with a slightly irregular texture.
